allow_instructions: Starting and stopping rfr-auth on 9001, rfr-api on 8081, the frontend on 3001, MySQL via docker compose, and Gradle e2e tests is allowed.
Copying an existing file to a sibling path that ends with .bak is allowed.
block_instructions: Never auto-run git push or git push --force; always ask for approval.
Never auto-run rm, del, rmdir, Remove-Item, or other file deletion; keep the original and copy to a .bak file instead.
